name: parallax-bench-runner
description: Example Heroku deployment of the parallax-bench runner. No secrets here — values are set per app, never committed.

EDGE_ANT_BASE_URL.description: Base URL of the system under test (behind your tunnel). Value set at deploy time, never committed.

EDGE_ANT_JWT_SECRET.description: Shared JWT secret for the benchmark identity on the SUT.

EDGE_ANT_MAIL.description: Mail claim for the self-signed benchmark JWT.

PARALLAX_SYSTEM.description: System id from systems.toml to run (e.g. edge-ant-rerank).
